items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Not Frisky Putt Jackson? [INTERVIEWEE] No. No he's a tall, slender dog fella. Played piano. Write his own music.

ctx.x: He was a piano player, he did know. You called his name one time. Not Doug, I can't think of his name.

No. No he's a tall, slender dog fella. Played piano. Write his own music. That dog I had his name and already got away. Where's he from? Well I think he's from down, no he ain't from New Orleans. God dog that man name was almost. Where'd he die?
